description: This is a PHP source file that implements a command-line installer script for the OrangeHRM system. It performs setup tasks such as checking dependencies, configuring database connections, storing installation state, running migrations, creating database users, writing configuration files, and initiating the installation process based on YAML configuration input.

classes.name: UserCredential
classes.description: Data transfer object representing database or user credentials used during installation.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration handler for the system, including installation check.

classes.name: Services
classes.description: Constants or registry for service identifiers.

classes.name: HttpKernel
classes.description: HTTP kernel for handling request lifecycle in different environments.

classes.name: AppSetupUtility
classes.description: Utility class responsible for executing installation steps like database setup, migrations, and configuration file generation.

classes.name: StateContainer
classes.description: Singleton class used for storing and retrieving installation state and configuration data.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: HTTP request representation used in installer API.

classes.name: InstallerDataRegistrationAPI
classes.description: API controller for handling registration data during installer process.

methods.name: isInstalled
methods.description: Checks whether the system is already installed.

methods.name: parseFile
methods.description: Parses a YAML configuration file into a PHP array.

methods.name: storeDbInfo
methods.description: Stores database connection information in the state container.

methods.name: setDbType
methods.description: Sets the type of database used for installation.

methods.name: storeInstanceData
methods.description: Stores initialization data for the system instance.

methods.name: createDatabase
methods.description: Creates the database as per configuration.

methods.name: writeKeyFile
methods.description: Writes encryption keys for data security.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the registration process during installation in the API controller.
